name: The Orchard Luxury Accommodation
signature: Three self-contained rammed-earth apartments on ten acres in Red Hill South wine country — infrared sauna, in-room spa baths, hosts Helen and Frank Haddy
editorNote:
Three self-contained apartments on ten acres in Red Hill South wine country — rammed-earth walls, in-room spa baths, infrared sauna, lake and valley views. Hosts Helen and Frank Haddy; Frank's direct mobile is on the website, which is the clearest possible signal about the hosting model: personal attention is the explicit product.

Small dogs welcome at a $50 fee. From $275 per night off-peak. Confirm whether a breakfast hamper is included as standard or whether this is self-catering — the pack notes it as unconfirmed.
whyWeGo: Rammed-earth, infrared sauna, Red Hill South wine country position — the most architecturally distinct cottage stay in the hinterland set.
ifOnlyOneThing: Confirm breakfast inclusion and dog policy directly — Frank's number is on the website.
dogFriendlyNotes: Small dogs welcome at a $50 fee. Confirm size and breed when booking.
